findings.evidence: First message shows "Signal: one step bolder and larger than the field label, icon"; second message shows "Signal: one step bolder and larger than the field label, none"
findings.fix: Either add an icon to the second email message or remove it from the first to establish consistent signal handling for the same field
findings.location: Signup form, email field, Message signals
findings.violation: Both validation messages for the same field use the same placement and container, but one includes an icon and the other doesn't, creating an inconsistent visual treatment for equally important validation feedback

findings.evidence: First email message uses "one step bolder and larger than the field label" while other messages use "bold text set larger than the field label"
